newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Viscoplast sets IPO issue price PLN 12-16.
newsitem.headline: Polish Viscoplast sets IPO issue price PLN 12-16.

text.p: The Polish chemical company Viscoplast set the issue price of its initial public offering of 900,000 shares at between 12 and 16 zlotys per share, the firm said in its abbreviated version of its issue prospectus.
It said the final issue price would be set through book- building and announced at least three days before the subscription begins.
A 690,000-share large-investor tranche will be issued from January 27 to February 5, with a maximum share amount for which investors may register at 65,000 shares.
Small investors will register for a total of 210,000 shares from January 27 to January 31.
Viscoplast, which seeks a parallel market listing, made a net profit of 3.6 million zlotys in 1995 on sales of 36 million zlotys.
It estimates its 1996 net profit down to 1.8 million and to 2.8 million this year.
